concerns.text: SC-006 (Power Analysis) is explicitly excluded in T030, but the spec defines SC-006 as a measurable outcome. The plan.md FR/SC matrix lists SC-006 as covered by 'analysis/power.py', yet no task exists to implement this script or generate the MDE calculation. This leaves a success criterion without an implementing task.

T035 references 'SC-004' for seed consistency, but the task description focuses on re-training and Kendall's Tau. While the logic covers the requirement, the task lacks an explicit tag or reference to the specific 'perturbation study' component of SC-004 (performance drop), which is handled separately in T029. Ensure T035 and T029 together fully satisfy SC-004's dual requirement (consistency + drop).
